file: DB_PATH env var, default data/pm.db (in Docker: /app/data/pm.db on the data volume)

columns.user_id: INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

boards.notes: UNIQUE user_id enforces one board per user for the MVP. Dropping UNIQUE later allows multiple boards.

columns.board_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

columns.notes: Fixed set of 5 per board, created with the board. Only the title changes.

columns.column_id: TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES columns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.title: TEXT NOT NULL

indexes: CREATE INDEX cards_column_position ON cards (column_id, position)
cards.notes: position is 0..n-1 within its column and is renumbered on every move or delete.

ids.columns: col-<12 hex chars>, generated by the backend
ids.cards: card-<12 hex chars>, generated by the backend

api_shape.description: GET /api/board returns the frontend BoardData shape, built from the tables above.
